feedback.problem: Let $u$ and $v$ be vectors such that $‖v‖=5$ and $‖2u+3v‖=17.$  If $u$ is orthogonal to $v$, find $‖u‖.$
feedback.worked_solution:
Since $u$ is orthogonal to $v,$ we also have that $2u$ is orthogonal to $3v.$ So, the Pythagorean theorem states that

$$
\begin{aligned}‖2u+3v{‖}^{2} & =‖2u{‖}^{2}+‖3v{‖}^{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Simplifying and substituting in the given information, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}‖2u+3v{‖}^{2} & =(2‖u‖)^{2}+(3‖v‖)^{2} \\ ‖2u+3v{‖}^{2} & =4‖u{‖}^{2}+9‖v{‖}^{2} \\ (17)^{2} & =4‖u{‖}^{2}+9(5)^{2} \\ 289 & =4‖u{‖}^{2}+9\cdot 25 \\ 289 & =4‖u{‖}^{2}+225 \\ 64 & =4‖u{‖}^{2} \\ ‖u{‖}^{2} & =16\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $‖u‖=4.$
